page.overview:
Who is Yushiro?

During the final confrontation with Muzan Kibutsuji, Yushiro, along with Tamayo, joins forces with the Demon Slayer Corps to aid the Demon Slayers.

Yushiro has the appearance of a young man of short stature and average build with pale skin and sharp, lavender eyes with black slit pupils. He has short hair that is neatly styled and vertically shaded from a mint green to black.

Yushiro wears a light blue-grey button-up collared shirt under an all-white iromuji-haori and dark blue Seigo-Sendeihira styled hakama pants. He wears pair of [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Z%C5%8Dri zōri] with dark blue straps and white [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tabi tabi socks].

When disguising himself as a Demon Slayer, he dons their standard black uniform, tinted green in the anime. The uniform consisted of a button-up jacket with a stand-up collar and long sleeves, featuring silver buttons, a shirt pocket on the left breast, and the kanji for |Metsu}} engraved on the back of the uniform. Beneath the jacket, he wears a white long-sleeved collared undershirt. He wears a matching tattsuke-hakama pants, and secured with a white belt. He wears green tabi socks and pair of zōri sandals with white straps. He also conceals his slit pupils similar to Tamayo. On his back, he carries a white backpack with medical supplies inside.
